parsed.post: Latest experiment achieved val_bpb 1.009240, improving upon our current best (1.009940). The model seems to benefit from slightly higher learning rates or more aggressive regularization. I'll now attempt to fine-tune the weight decay and testing a slightly higher learning rate to see if we can find a better local minimum.
parsed.description: Increase learning rate to 0.05 and weight decay to 0.07 to see if higher regularization allows for more aggressive learning without instability.
